item.title: Goodest Dog Wet 80g Pack of 24 (Beef and Liver, Grilled Chicken and Liver, Braised Beef w/ Veggies)
item.description:
Just like Sarah and Matteo, we love our pets so we only give them the GOODEST! 🧡

Try 3 APPETIZING FLAVORS: Beef and Liver Steak, Grilled Chicken and Liver, and Braised Beef with Veggies -- your dog will surely be wagging their tails for more! Available in 80G and 130G Pouches.

✅ MADE WITH REAL MEAT, a source of high quality protein for your dogs!
✅ COMPLETE & BALANCED NUTRITION meeting AAFCO* Standards.
✅ LOW IN SODIUM to support urinary health
✅ VET-FORMULATED FOR ALL LIFESTAGES, ensuring optimum nutrition for puppies, adult, and senior dogs!
✅ ENRICHED WITH ESSENTIAL NUTRIENTS: calcium, sodium, zinc, Vitamins A & E. These nutrients support (1) healthy skin, (2) shiny coat, (3) sharp eyesight, and (4) a strong immune system.

Give your dog the AffordaGOODEST nutrition they deserve, arf! 🐶

*AAFCO stands for the Association of American Feed Control Officials that set a standard for pet food with clear guidelines on what nutrients pets need to stay healthy across different lifestages.

Bureau Of Animal Industry (BAl) - Certificate of Feed Product Registration (CFPR): Beef and Liver (SF-DFL1-23-5155462809), Grilled Chicken and Liver (SF-DFL1-23-5155562810) and Braised Beef with Veggies (SF-DFL1-23-5155562817).
